nextReadySlice.title: Blueprint HTTP startup and endpoint-mapping measurement follow-on
dependsOn: BlueprintApp runtime hotspot redesign completed and reviewed
failingProof: BenchmarkDotNet or a focused startup measurement captures the current endpoint-mapping cost through ApplicationBuilderExtensions before any host-path optimization.
Runtime tests or a measurement harness prove mapped endpoint counts and attached descriptor metadata stay stable while the startup path is measured or refined.
The new startup/endpoint-mapping artifact compares against the updated BlueprintApp registration and lookup baseline rather than the old pre-redesign numbers.
nextReadySlice.reviewGate: Require code review before closing the first Blueprint HTTP startup/endpoint-mapping measurement slice.

current.openReviewGate: None before the Blueprint HTTP startup/endpoint-mapping measurement slice starts.
